source_evidence: The financial strength of the insurance company that issues the policy backs all guarantees, including the death benefit. If the insurance company experiences financial distress, it may not be able to pay what it owes you under the policy.
answer: Insurance company credit risk is the possibility that the insurer may be unable to meet its obligations. With variable life insurance, the insurer’s financial strength backs policy guarantees, including the death benefit. If the insurer experiences financial distress, it may not be able to pay what it owes under the policy. This is a risk separate from how the investment options perform.
